test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Foundational Full Test - 07
subject: general
question:
Consider the following pairs of **Paramilitary & Other Auxiliary Civil Force contingents **and their **leaders **as per the Republic Day 2026 demonstrations:

1. Central Industrial Security Force ... : Sub Inspector Karan Singh

2. Central Reserve Police Force ... : Assistant Commandant Simran Bala

3. Indo-Tibetan Border Police ... : Assistant Commissioner of Police Anant Dhanraj Singh

How many of the above pairs is/are **correctly **matched?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 2 (Two only)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Pair 1 is correctly matched as the CISF contingent was led by Sub Inspector Karan Singh.
 
• Pair 2 is correctly matched since the CRPF contingent was headed by Assistant Commandant Simran Bala (along with another officer).
 
• Pair 3 is **not correctly matched** because the ITBP contingent was not led by an ACP of Delhi Police.
 
• Hence, only **two** pairs are **correctly matched**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Central Industrial Security Force (CISF)
 
 
• Parade contingent showcased industrial and infrastructure security role.
 
• Led by Sub Inspector Karan Singh during Republic Day Parade 2026.
 
• CISF functions under the Ministry of Home Affairs.
 
 
 
• Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF)
 
 
• World’s largest central armed police force.
 
• Contingent headed by Assistant Commandant Simran Bala and Assistant Commandant Surabhi Ravi.
 
• Plays a key role in internal security and counter-insurgency.
 
 
 
• Indo-Tibetan Border Police (ITBP)
 
 
• Specialised force for high-altitude border guarding.
 
• Republic Day Parade 2026 contingent was led by Band Master-ASI Devindra Singh.
 
• Operates primarily along the India-China border.
